title: Sonnet 4.6, Pierre Diffs
summary: Sonnet 4.6 is now live in Conductor!
html:
Sonnet 4.6 is now live in Conductor!

We've replaced our diff viewer with a more accurate and beautiful diff engine.

We’ve brought back more info about each workspace in the sidebar, so you can tell at a glance what repo and directory you’re in.

Improvements

  • You can now drag and drop to reorder repositories in the sidebar.
  • Adjustments to chat tab sizing
  • You can now toggle sidebar visibility from the View menu

Fixes

  • Clarify branch rename instruction, which Codex was misinterpreting
  • Fix a bug where the right sidebar toggle button would incorrectly appear on the home page
  • Fix an issue with textarea autoresizing in the UI for Claude's ask-a-question tool
  • Fixed a bug where AI-generated chat titles might override manual changes
markdown:
Sonnet 4.6 is now live in Conductor!
![image](/assets/changelog/media/0.36.0/1771359980844-image.png)

We've replaced our diff viewer with a more accurate and beautiful [diff](http://diffs.com/) engine.
![image](/assets/changelog/media/0.36.0/1771359981518-image.png)

We’ve brought back more info about each workspace in the sidebar, so you can tell at a glance what repo and directory you’re in.
![image](/assets/changelog/media/0.36.0/1771359982278-image.png)

## Improvements

- You can now drag and drop to reorder repositories in the sidebar.
- Adjustments to chat tab sizing
- You can now toggle sidebar visibility from the View menu

## Fixes

- Clarify branch rename instruction, which Codex was misinterpreting
- Fix a bug where the right sidebar toggle button would incorrectly appear on the home page
- Fix an issue with textarea autoresizing in the UI for Claude's ask-a-question tool
- Fixed a bug where AI-generated chat titles might override manual changes
